quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (July 2025 - June 2026) results: orders received recovered to JPY 237,504 million from JPY 105,226 million a year earlier, but, because of the prior year's orders, net sales fell 8.3% to JPY 230,485 million. By item: semiconductor-related equipment JPY 168,090 million (down 17.2%), other products JPY 3,747 million (down 32.5%), services JPY 58,646 million (up 36.5%). Operating income JPY 105,259 million (down 14.3%), ordinary income JPY 107,895 million (down 9.7%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 77,485 million (down 8.5%). Management states that in the semiconductor industry, its main market, AI data-center demand rose further on strong investment toward deploying agentic AI, and high demand for advanced chips such as CPUs, GPUs and HBM drove market growth.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 230,485 million (-8.3%); operating income JPY 105,259 million (-14.3%); services JPY 58,646 million (+36.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 orders and backlog by item: orders received JPY 237,504 million (up 125.7%), of which semiconductor-related equipment JPY 172,216 million (up 208.5%), other products JPY 3,497 million, services JPY 61,791 million (up 35.8%). Order backlog at June 30, 2026 JPY 322,964 million (up 2.2%), of which semiconductor-related equipment JPY 301,303 million (up 1.4%), other products JPY 4,311 million, services JPY 17,349 million (up 22.1%). Management states that recent cash needs are large because of R&D spending on EUV-related products and work-in-process spending to handle the high order backlog.
quarterly_data.figure: Orders JPY 237,504 million (+125.7%); backlog JPY 322,964 million (+2.2%), equipment backlog JPY 301,303 million

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 production (at selling prices): total JPY 226,774 million, down 12.2%; semiconductor-related equipment JPY 164,758 million, down 21.7%; other products JPY 3,369 million, down 32.8%; services JPY 58,646 million, up 36.5%.
quarterly_data.figure: Production JPY 226,774 million (-12.2%); equipment JPY 164,758 million (-21.7%)

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 net sales by customer location: Korea JPY 66,075 million (FY2025: JPY 53,645 million), US JPY 51,610 million (JPY 67,938 million), Taiwan JPY 45,854 million (JPY 65,268 million), other Asia JPY 31,056 million (JPY 23,615 million), Japan JPY 28,127 million (JPY 20,687 million), Europe JPY 7,759 million (JPY 20,320 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Korea JPY 66,075 million; US JPY 51,610 million; Taiwan JPY 45,854 million

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term management plan covering the six fiscal years from FY2025 (June 2025) to FY2030 (June 2030): targets of net sales of 4,000 to 5,000 (100 million yen) and an operating margin of 35% or more, plus a service share of net sales of 20% or more. The company also aims to keep an operating margin of 20% or more even in a market downturn. The plan is reviewed every year.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2030 targets: net sales 4,000-5,000 (100 million yen); operating margin 35%+; services 20%+ of sales

quarterly_data.signal: Management states that demand for its equipment has risen with the growth of the semiconductor market and longer lead times have become an issue: lead time was 1.5 to 2 years when the medium-term plan was drawn up, and the company aims to cut it to 0.5 to 1.5 years through resource optimization and training, optimizing manufacturing sites, improving manufacturing and tool start-up processes, stronger manufacturing control, more efficient parts procurement and equipment designs that simplify adjustment. Under its fab-light strategy, much of product manufacturing is outsourced to partner companies.

New products launched in FY2026 from R&D: the EUV pellicle particle inspection system PELMIS EPM200 for CNT (carbon nanotube) pellicles, which automatically classifies particles on the front or back side; the ACTIS A200HiT series actinic EUV patterned-mask defect inspection system, with optimized optics and a renewed inspection system that greatly raise throughput and with the sensitivity to detect all printable defects arising in wafer fabs; the OPTELICS UXM ultra-short-pulse-laser-excited microscope for non-destructive 3D evaluation of internal defects in wide-bandgap compound semiconductor wafers; the MAGICS M9750/M9751 mask blank defect inspection/review systems, with renewed inspection optics, higher sensitivity to small defects and a high-precision X-Y stage for defect mitigation in EUV mask making; and the MATRICS X712 series mask defect inspection system for 5/6/7-inch masks. FY2026 R&D expenses totaled JPY 16,292 million; the company is also developing AI-based automatic defect classification.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 16,292 million; ACTIS A200HiT, PELMIS EPM200, MAGICS M9750/M9751 launched

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 capital expenditure was JPY 2,361 million, with no significant retirement or sale of facilities; the report states no significant plans for new facilities or retirements as of the fiscal year end. Main facilities: the Yokohama head office and the Lasertec Innovation Park (development and manufacturing), both in Kohoku-ku, Yokohama.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 2,361 million; no significant new-facility plans
